given.note: Another browser holds Sam's attempt id (copied or guessed) and checks the right code with its own device cookie. sign_in_attempt answers no row for any device but the one the attempt started on, so the call answers attemptNotFound alone, the same as for an unknown id: nothing of the attempt is told, no try is counted, the code is not checked and nothing is written (K-21 README line 117; K-22 rule 9's check, step 1).
